Name: Red Panda Bazaar (English)
Author: Solariaze
Description:
[size=5][b]New NPCs[/b][/size]
[size=3]Adds 3 NPCs with distinctive personalities, including 2 marriageable female NPCs with 8 sets of post-marriage dialogues.[/size]

[size=5][b]New Locations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Adds a sign next to the bus providing access to the Red Panda Bazaar.[/size]
[*][size=3]There are many shops in the market selling different items. You can buy what you need at different points in the game.[/size]
[*][size=3]A lottery machine has been added to the bazaar, and tickets can be purchased from a certain NPC's store.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=5]New Food[/size]
[/b][size=3]Adds a lot of new foods, and some foods have special buffs, adding fun and help to your game progress.[/size]

[b][size=5]New Festival[/size]
[/b][list]
[*][size=3]Adds a new festival on the 8th day of spring: the Spring Fair.[/size]
[*][size=3]At that time, residents of Red Panda Bazaar and Pelican Town will come here to sell their respective products.[/size]
[*][size=3]You can also play mini games to get star tokens to redeem rewards![/size]
[/list]
[b][size=5]New decoration[/size]
[/b][size=3]Adds some new furniture and new clothes to give you more personalization options![/size]

[size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]If you don’t know where to use the redemption coupon, you can check [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30982?tab=images]Image[/url] page。[/size]
[*][size=3]If you use the CJB Cheats Menu to change the date to 8th Spring, you may not be able to play the minigames at the Spring Fair.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Red Panda Bazaar is compatible with SVE, RSV and East Scarp.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24934]Qingfeng - Custom NPC[/url] (but it is not recommended to install both two).'[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3]If you encounter any bugs, kindly report them to the original mod author. Only report dialogue related bugs to me.[/size]
